parsed.rationale: Both `LCDMinOffsetKey` and `LCDMaxOffsetKey` are type-alias objects defined in the same file (`AccentColorEnvironment.swift`) within the `PlayerHeaderView` package, just four lines apart (lines 31 and 35). Although they share structural shape (both are empty type-alias objects), they encode semantically distinct concepts — a minimum offset key and a maximum offset key — that are intentionally paired as separate SwiftUI `EnvironmentKey` types. Collapsing them would destroy the semantic distinction between the two offset bounds. No refactor is warranted.
